entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need some help with a recent order. I bought a jersey and I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Performance Jersey. It looks like it was delivered 23 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's simply the wrong size. I thought a medium would work, but it's just too tight across the chest. I'd like to do an exchange for a large if possible.

Understood. One moment while I review the return eligibility for this item... Okay, I've checked the policy. That jersey is a standard apparel item, so it falls under our 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process that exchange for you.

That's great, thank you. Now, since I have to package this up and make a trip to send it back, would you be able to add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase? Just for the hassle of getting the wrong size.

I certainly understand your position. While I'm not able to provide a discount for a standard size exchange, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. We'll email you a prepaid label so there's no cost on your end to send the jersey back.
I see. Okay, well if a discount isn't possible, could you at least expedite the shipping on the new size? It would be nice to get it quickly.

The replacement order ships with the same standard 3-5 business day speed. Our system processes these automatically, and I can't override that part of the process. However, I can assure you the new order will be created the moment the carrier scans your return package. Would you like me to proceed with setting up the exchange for a size large?
Alright, that's fair. Yes, please start the exchange. The free return label is helpful.
Perfect. I've just initiated it. You will receive an email with the return label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and happy holidays.
